column3: “Fir trees” is a rare word (perhaps juniper or cypress).
“Pine from the islands of Kittim” is rendered “boxwood from the coastlands of Cyprus,” and “boards” as “deck.”
“Sail” (first) is rendered “sail,” and “to become a sail” as “your distinguishing mark.”
“Skillful people” is rendered “wise men,” and “sailors” as “pilots.”
“Gebal” is kept; “repairers of leaks” is rendered “repairing your seams.”
“Dedan” follows the Hebrew; the LXX reads “Rhodes.” “Tribute” is rendered “payment.”
“Aram” follows the Hebrew; many manuscripts read “Edom.” “Turquoise” is rendered “emeralds.”
“Cake” is a rare word; the meaning is uncertain.
“Vedan” is kept; the text is uncertain. “Calamus” is rendered “sweet cane.”
“Clothes of material for riding” is rendered “saddlecloths.”
“Pasturelands” is uncertain here; NASB keeps “pasture lands.”
